description: Prior Authorization Requirements Matrix has authority_status = Draft and no implemented structured-to-knowledge linkage. The document is present and discoverable in the corpus but is not yet authoritative and is not yet wired into any confirmed retrieval path.
detection_point: Metadata validation / governance gate prior to indexing for retrieval
intended_use: Tests whether future retrieval and indexing logic checks authority_status before surfacing a document, and whether orphaned (unlinked) documents are flagged for review rather than silently indexed.

location: metadata/document_metadata.csv, doc_id = HLT-POL-002; referenced by LNK-002 in metadata/structured_to_knowledge_linkages.csv
description: Silver HMO Plan Benefits Booklet (2024) has authority_status = Superseded. It is the correct retrieval target only when claims_ledger.claim_service_start_date falls within its effective period (2024); it is the wrong document for current-year claims.
detection_point: Point-in-time retrieval logic at claim evaluation; freshness/currency check
intended_use: Tests whether retrieval logic correctly applies point-in-time matching (service date vs. document effective/superseded status) instead of naively matching only on plan_type and coverage_region.

description: A near-duplicate claim record: the same underlying claim (same member_id, provider_id, plan_id, and service dates) submitted a second time with a different claim_id and a later claim_received_date, simulating a provider resubmission rather than an exact duplicate row.
intended_use: Tests whether the ingestion pipeline detects and quarantines or merges near-duplicate claims rather than treating each as an independent event, which would inflate claim counts and billed/paid totals.
